title: Placement and destination occupancy
tags: at visit place target holding hand occupied
advice: A placement failed its destination-capacity precondition. Before placing, account for any occupying object and current hand occupancy. Temporary placement can be needed before moving a blocker. Preserve all goals and prohibitions; this experience does not authorize moving a protected object.

title: Unknown history and first-visit order

advice: Unknown historical placement evidence caused an incorrect conflict/ready claim. Evaluate all evidence alternatives for first-visit ordering. Repeating an action cannot replace an earlier first event. Respect each visit's activation time; request evidence only when no common valid suffix exists and some alternatives remain feasible.
